2608.01827.title: DeepVoyager-VL: Incentivizing Vision-in-the-Loop Search for Long-Horizon Multimodal Agents
2608.01827.paper_summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced visual understanding and reasoning, yet their static parametric knowledge limits their ability to address knowledge-intensive and dynamically evolving open-world problems. To move beyond this limitation, multimodal deep search has emerged as a key direction for open-world information access, evolving from single-turn factual retrieval toward long-horizon, multi-turn search guided by visual evidence. However, existing methods typically confine vision to the input or answer stage, overlooking its role in intermediate reasoning, and lack designs tailored to long-horizon interaction. Consequently, visual evidence rarely drives continued retrieval, constraining both interaction depth and reasoning span. To address these limitations, we propose DeepVoyager-VL, a long-horizon multimodal deep-search framework for vision-in-the-loop search. Specifically, we construct a multimodal event graph to drive data synthesis, yielding problems with intermediate visual dependencies and long reasoning chains. We then design an agent framework for active visual acquisition and on-demand image loading. Finally, we fine-tune models on the synthesized data without reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments across ten multimodal search benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
2608.01827.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在視覺理解和推理方面取得了進展，但其靜態參數知識限制了它們解決知識密集和動態演變的開放世界問題的能力。為了超越這一限制，多模態深度搜索已成為開放世界信息訪問的關鍵方向，從單輪事實檢索發展到由視覺證據引導的長期、多輪搜索。然而，現有方法通常將視覺限制在輸入或回答階段，忽視了其在中間推理中的作用，並缺乏針對長期互動的設計。因此，視覺證據很少驅動持續檢索，限制了互動深度和推理範圍。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了DeepVoyager-VL，一個長期多模態深度搜索框架，用於視覺環路搜索。具體而言，我們構建了一個多模態事件圖來驅動數據合成，產生具有中間視覺依賴和長推理鏈的問題。然後，我們設計了一個代理框架，用於主動視覺獲取和按需圖像加載。最後，我們在合成數據上對模型進行微調，無需強化學習。在十個多模態搜索基準上進行的大量實驗證明了我們方法的有效性。
